title: MarketWire: MOTH ships dashboard, no listing announced
contentExcerpt: We accessed the public MOTH dashboard today. It shows activity data but no new fee capture for holders. MOTH has risen 18% over the last hour; the launch could already be priced in. No exchange has announced a MOTH or FERN listing in the available record.
